#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    long long n, m;
    scanf("%lld %lld", &n, &m);
    long long min = std::min(n, m);
    long long max = std::max(n, m);
    long long result = min * max;

    if (min == 1) {
        long long deduct[] = {0, 1, 2, 3, 2, 1};
        result -= deduct[max % 6];
    } else if (min == 2) {
        if (max == 2) {
            result = 0;
        } else if (max == 3 || max == 7) {
            result -= 2;
        }
    } else {
        result &= ~1LL;
    }

    printf("%lld\n", result);
    return 0;
}
